_comment: The inn's upstairs (private quarters). FIXTURE-FIRST: no fixture needed -- every beat here (the stairs door pair, Lyonette's locked door, the PC's own bed) is reachable from a bare fresh start with zero prior accomplishments/classes, unlike DP1's guild script which needed pre-banked hub-gating state. #49: the ground-floor alcove `bed` is REMOVED -- `your_bed` up here is the inn's ONLY bed now, so this script no longer proves a baseline-vs-upstairs sleep comparison; it proves the stairs door pair, Lyonette's locked door, and the sleep beat live at `your_bed` directly (phase_changed + the plain 'You sleep soundly.' fallback, PLUS one extra flavor toast, 'Your own bed.', fired before them). Seed 9 for convention (no rng consumed by anything in this walk -- no combat, no skill checks).

steps._comment: The ground floor's stairs_up/inn_chest swap is a wash for total count (13 -> 14 via the short_order pot -> 16 via pantry_door+rift_vermin_leak -> 17 via pantry_door_runes -> 18 via garden_door -> 17 via #49's bed removal), but issue #62 finding 4 then moves inn_chest OFF this map entirely (its old cell now holds the relocated stairs_up instead) -> 17 -> 16.

Issue #62 finding 4: == UP THE STAIRS: the stairs relocated to the bottom-left corner (the herringbone 'bedroom corner' floor swatch), replacing inn_chest at its old cell -- fresh boot spawns at (2,3), down3 -> (2,6), left1 -> (1,6), down1 -> (1,7), face down (blocked by the stairs) and interact. Same approach route the chest used to use before it moved upstairs.
#129 continuity proof: upstairs resolves to the already-playing inn stream, so no second music play event may fire.

Chronology mirrors guild_door: transition() fires map_changed synchronously, world.gd rebuilds the field (mood/map/entities) BEFORE wi_game.gd's interact() records on_enter_accomplishment -- visited_own_room asserted AFTER the render events.

blocked_cells 38 -> 36 (): the two generic hallway doors at (3,1)/(5,1) were non-entity decor ADDED to the static `blocked` list; promoted to real `prop` entities (see below), so their cells are now blocked by entity occupancy instead (ui_map_rendered's blocked_cells payload is the static-list+wall-segment union ONLY, per barracks_walkthrough's own comment -- entity cells were never counted either way, so removing them from the static list is a real -2).

6 entities (stairs_down, your_bed, lyonette_door, hallway_door_a, hallway_door_b, inn_chest -- issue #62 finding 4's relocated chest) + the PC's own sprite (render_counts counts the PC too, world.gd's _count_visual(_player_visual, ...) call) = 7. the two generic hallway doors are now real entities instead of non-entity decor.
MOOD CARD SHOT: the warm-dim inn_upstairs grade against the hallway + your-room floor variant.

steps._comment: Issue #62 finding 4: == THE TWO GENERIC HALLWAY DOORS: arrival lands at (1,1) now; (1,2) is stairs_down itself (blocked), so detour one column east before dropping to the y2 hallway lane: right1 -> (2,1), down1 -> (2,2), right1 -> (3,2), up1 blocks on hallway_door_a (3,1) & faces it. Previously non-entity decor (a facing interact hit empty space -> INTERACT_NOTHING's 'Nothing there.'); now a real prop with a generic locked_toast.
Still at (3,2) -- a blocked bump never moves the player. right2 -> (5,2), up1 blocks on hallway_door_b (5,1) & faces it -- the second of the two.

== LYONETTE'S DOOR: still at (5,2) -- right2 -> (7,2), up1 blocks on lyonette_door (7,1) & faces it. Plain interact (no requires_skill set) falls through interact()'s use_skill('', id) branch -- the same skill-less-locked-prop seam sewers' sewer_debris already uses -- straight to the bespoke locked_toast.

payload_contains.text: Locked. Lyonette keeps exactly one door in this inn that isn't anyone's business but hers.

steps._comment: == YOUR BED: (7,2) right2 -> (9,2) (plain floor -- issue #62 finding 1 REMOVED the rug outright, it no longer sits anywhere near here), up1 blocks on your_bed (9,1) & faces it. sleep_toast fires FIRST, then sleep()'s own stream.

Issue #76 signature stinger: music_sleep_beat (xDeviruchi 'Peaceful Night', ui_sleep_veil_rendered) fires as part of THIS sleep -- assert_event_logged (whole-run scan) rather than wait_for_event since the veil's own reveal timing relative to the toast stream isn't pinned here, only that it happened.

Issue #62 finding 4: == BACK DOWNSTAIRS: (9,2) left7 -> (2,2) (stairs_down itself now blocks (1,2), so the old direct left8 no longer reaches it), up1 -> (2,1), left1 -> (1,1), down1 blocks on stairs_down (1,2) & faces it, interact -> lands back at (1,7) in the inn (matching the relocated stairs_up's own approach cell), round-trip integrity.
